target_moa.text: Fully human IgG1 monoclonal antibody that binds PD-L1 and blocks its interaction with PD-1 and B7.1, releasing inhibition of the anti-tumor immune response; also induces antibody-dependent cell-mediated cytotoxicity (ADCC) in vitro.

citations.quote: Cosibelimab-ipdl (Unloxcyt) is an immunoglobulin G type 1 (IgG1), fully human monoclonal antibody against the programmed death ligand-1 (PD-L1). Cosibelimab-ipdl binds PD-L1 and blocks the interaction between PD-L1 and its receptors PD-1 and B7.1. This interaction releases the inhibitory effects of PD-L1 on the anti-tumor immune response.
Cosibelimab-ipdl has also been shown to induce antibody-dependent cell-mediated cytotoxicity (ADCC) in vitro.

key_safety.text: Most common adverse reactions (≥10%): fatigue, musculoskeletal pain, rash, diarrhea, hypothyroidism, constipation, nausea, headache, pruritus, edema, localized infection, and urinary tract infection. Serious adverse reactions occurred in 31% of patients; most frequent (≥2%) were sepsis (2.8%), pneumonia (2.8%), and pyrexia (2.1%). Immune-mediated adverse reactions can occur in any organ system.
